{"id":1907026595,"question_id":3994,"lang":"cpp","lang_name":"C++","time":"5 months, 2 weeks","timestamp":1770139120,"status":10,"status_display":"Accepted","runtime":"3 ms","url":"/submissions/detail/1907026595/","is_pending":"Not Pending","title":"Find The Least Frequent Digit","memory":"8.9 MB","code":"class Solution {\npublic:\n    int getLeastFrequentDigit(int n) {\n        map<int , int>mp;\n        while(n > 0)\n        {\n            mp[n % 10]++;\n            n /= 10;\n        }\n\n        int ans = 0;\n        int mini = INT_MAX;\n\n        for(auto it : mp)\n        {\n            if(it.second < mini)\n            {\n                mini = it.second;\n                ans = it.first;\n            }\n        }\n        return ans;\n    }\n};","compare_result":"","title_slug":"find-the-least-frequent-digit","has_notes":false,"flag_type":1,"frontend_id":1638}
